source.description:
PROBLEM
Specialists today execute via `sp run` -> PiAgentSession -> `spawn('pi', args)` subprocess RPC (src/pi/session.ts:1022). That makes a Specialist operationally separate from the coordinator's live session, so coordinators fall back to generic Pi subagents, manual sp run, or doing the work directly. Specialists are also one-shot: a child dies at the end of a turn, cannot ask a clarifying question and resume, and cannot be attached to.

SUCCESS
A canonical NativeActivationHost in xtrm-dev/specialists hosts persistent, interactive, Bead-backed Pi AgentSession children. Pi (via extension) and Claude Code (via MCP plugin) are thin frontends over the same runtime; a future XTRM Chain scheduler can call it without TUI state. observability.db remains the single forensic store. Exactly one writer per mutable workspace, coordinator included.

SCOPE
Implements ~/dev/xtrm/docs/specialists/PRD-Native-Specialist-Subagents-for-Pi.md (em-dash filename, 4517 lines) phases 0-15, acceptance matrix A-BI. Child beads carry per-phase contracts.

NON_GOALS
Chain scheduler, ResolvedChain lifecycle, Substrate daemon/state-store, native Substrate step-issue creation, seed containers, epic/wave/node runtime, automatic worktree provisioning per Specialist, automatic merge/publish, multi-host or networked Specialist transport, replacing pi-intercom / pi-claude-link / XTRM Channels / Beads, Claude-native Specialist reimplementation. Legacy `sp run` path is not removed in this epic.

CONSTRAINTS
Runtime stays in xtrm-dev/specialists; no move into Core. Pi extension must NOT be tool -> `sp run` subprocess; Claude integration must NOT be MCP -> Bash -> `sp run`. Both call shared library code directly. SpecialistLoader stays authoritative; no second resolver. No telemetry side database. Public Pi SDK APIs only where possible. Incremental reviewable commits; no giant rewrite of the legacy runner before the shared seams are proven.

VALIDATION
PRD section 130 acceptance matrix A-BI (47 scenarios) as automated tests plus integration smokes. Per-phase child beads carry their own VALIDATION.

OUTPUT
Working native activation runtime, Pi extension, Claude Code plugin/MCP server, adapted using-specialists skill, feature-parity matrix, developer/operator docs.

SCRUTINY
HIGH. Touches capability/permission resolution, workspace mutation authority, and the forensic store. A lease bug silently allows two concurrent writers in one worktree; a capability regression grants a child tools its Specialist definition denies.
source.title: Native interactive XTRM Specialists (Pi AgentSession + Claude Code)
